title: Subjectifying the Personality State: Theoretical Underpinnings and an Empirical Example
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample size is small; - Reliability estimates for some modes were moderate; - Assessment intervals may have been too sparse to capture true causal links; - The study is exploratory and lacks preregistration.
notes: The study was not preregistered. The code and data are available on OSF at https://osf.io/jkxzn/. The authors note that the study was exploratory and did not preregister hypotheses.
